purpose: Imagine what would be happening if past circumstances had differed.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Counterfactual たら / ば + Vている / V dictionary + ところだ
If I had caught the train, I would be looking at the sea by now.
If I had managed to get leave, I would be hiking now.
If I had not found the key, I would have been waiting outside.
formation: Counterfactual たら / ば + Vている / V dictionary + ところだ
restrictions: The imagined scene contrasts with the actual present or past.
mistake: Give enough context to make the unreal condition clear.
